stem:
Scientists are studying a bacteria sample. The function f(x) = 245(1.12)^x gives the number of bacteria in the sample at the end of x days.

Which statement is the best interpretation of one of the values in this function?

options.label: F
options.text: The initial number of bacteria is 12.

options.label: G
options.text: The initial number of bacteria decreases at a rate of 88% each day.

options.label: H
options.text: The number of bacteria increases at a rate of 12% each day.

options.label: J
options.text: The number of bacteria at the end of one day is 245.
